data.signal_type: SA Connect Phase 2 School and Clinic Connectivity
data.description: Government's SA Connect initiative is funding connectivity for unconnected schools and clinics. Each school/clinic requiring broadband represents an infrastructure anchor tenant.

data.signal_type: Mining Company Social and Labour Plans (SLPs)
data.description: Mining companies are obligated under MPRDA to invest in community upliftment through SLPs. Connectivity for mining host communities (townships) is a growing SLP commitment. Vcom can partner with or supply to mining house SLP programmes.
data.monitoring_source: DMRE SLP database / Mining company annual reports

data.description: Smart city programmes in Johannesburg (Joburg Connect), Tshwane, eThekwini, and others require physical fibre backbone and community Wi-Fi networks. Watch for IDP updates and smart city budget announcements.
data.monitoring_source: Municipal IDP portals and council meeting agendas

data.signal_type: Tourism and Public Space Wi-Fi Programmes
data.description: DTIC (Department of Trade, Industry and Competition) and Tourism departments fund Wi-Fi at public spaces, parks, and tourist areas. Requires aerial fibre backbone.
